rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for the worst person or thing when the context makes the referent clear.

example.english: He is the worst on the whole team.
example.traditional: 成隊波入面，佢係最差嗰個。
example.jyutping: sing4 deoi6 bo1 jap6 min6 keoi5 hai6 zeoi3 caa1 go3 go3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the least good option or result, including a generally unfavorable one.

example.english: The service at this restaurant is the worst.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 zeoi3 caa1

rows.note: Choose this when stressing that news, circumstances, or an outcome is bad or harmful overall rather than specifically severe.

example.english: The worst news is that the shop has to close.
example.traditional: 最壞嘅消息係間舖要結業。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 waai6 ge3 siu1 sik1 hai6 gaan1 pou2 jiu3 git3 jip6

rows.note: Use this for the greatest degree of severity, such as the most severe storm, injury, or situation.

example.english: This fire is the worst incident in the district.
example.traditional: 今次場火係區內最嚴重嘅一宗。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 coeng4 fo2 hai6 keoi1 noi6 zeoi3 jim4 zung6 ge3 jat1 zung1

rows.note: Use this when “the worst one” has an understood noun, supplying the appropriate classifier and noun after 嗰.

example.english: Among these proposals, the worst one costs the most.
example.traditional: 呢幾個方案入面，最差嗰個方案成本最高。
example.jyutping: ni1 gei2 go3 fong1 on3 jap6 min6 zeoi3 caa1 go2 go3 fong1 on3 sing4 bun2 zeoi3 gou1
